column1: # citations.tsv — paper-to-paper edges for the citation graph
# Tab-separated. Lines starting with '#' are comments. Header row is required.
# Edit by hand; co-edit with `clusters.tsv` for the lineage / temporal views.
#   from      paper_id of the citing/extending paper (Pxxx)
#   to        paper_id of the cited/parent paper    (Pxxx)
#               same-team           — same lab / first-author cluster, no direct inheritance
#               competing-route     — same problem, different design route
#               critical-review-of  — paper specifically argues against another's claims
#               dataset-target      — citing paper uses cited paper as evaluation target
#   evidence  short text pointing to where in the citing paper this is asserted
# Validation: scripts/citation_graph.py rejects unknown relations and any
